summary: Captain, the shell of your Tide Board is here — the tab bar is flush with Readings underlined, the notice reads right on two lines, Open the board reaches the board screen, and the note box takes text — but the mission's own point is broken: Lock the board publishes an empty note instead of refusing while the note is blank, so the gate does not gate. On top of that the stale-readings chip is green and reads as healthy when it must be red, the Export CSV button is missing entirely, Publish board is half-width and wraps to two lines, the Save reading icon is oversized and spills its control, and Help sits on the left instead of top-right. I'm recommending LOW: a high-impact requirement (the blank-note lock gate) does not work.
